class.name: DisSetDataPdu
class.brief_description: Set Data PDU (type 19): asks the receiver to set the given values.
class.description: A Set Data PDU asks the receiver to set the values in its datum records, identified by datum ID. [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id] identifies the request. [DisExerciseControl] does not act on Set Data PDUs; handle the network signal yourself.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Set Data PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Set Data PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], fewer than 40 bytes, or datum counts and datum records that do not fit in the length). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last datum, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].
